scope: 55 saved items from semantic-claims-v1; no new sampling
authorization: 2026-10-23用户要求继续后续工作直到长期GPU；当前可执行项为有历史暴露的逐主张复核、离线连接与研究决策。
process: Read all 55 questions and all 275 document slots via 140 exact-text unique documents
Manually record and seal input judgments before current-pass output decomposition; disclose earlier output exposure
Read all 55 complete outputs and manually split separately assessable target, attribution, absence, conflict and other factual claims
Preserve exact output spans, document references, missing links, ambiguity and rationale for every claim
Join sealed sources only after claim judgments are saved; retain old judgments and blank independent templates
Compute descriptive counts and explicit old/new judgment differences without generalization or new significance testing

semantics.supported: Provided text entails claim, including explicitly stated ordinary equivalences; note reliance on linguistic inference
semantics.contradicted: Provided text entails an incompatible claim in the same entity/relation/scope; overbroad absence or conflict assertions may be contradicted by the supplied compatible evidence
semantics.unsupported: Claim is not entailed and no supplied incompatible proposition establishes its negation; missing evidence is not external falsity
semantics.ambiguous: Reasonable interpretation, referent, scope or language-inference choices change support judgment
semantics.conflict: Must specify incompatible propositions under matching entity, attribute and scope; unknown is not itself a conflict
semantics.coverage: Every asserted factual/evidence-status content must be represented; one verbatim span may ground several separately judged propositions
semantics.separate_endpoints: Specific target answer support and support of every explanation claim are evaluated separately; mixed rows remain mixed
